headline: Lowe's beat estimates with comps +0.4% as higher tickets offset a 3% drop in transactions; trimmed FY2025 comp outlook to flat.
guidance_note: FY2025 sales raised to ~$86.0bn (FBM), comps now flat, adj EPS ~$12.25 (was $12.20-12.45).
key_messages: Comps +0.4% beat expectations: ticket +3.4% (Pro, appliances, mix, modest price increases), transactions -3.0%.
Online sales +11.4%, double-digit home services growth and continued Pro gains.
Larger discretionary purchases pressured by elevated borrowing costs; DIY big-ticket soft.
Adj EPS $3.06 (+5.9%) beat ~$2.97; closed the $8.8bn FBM acquisition.
Shares rebounded ~3-5% early after a sell-off tied to Home Depot's miss.

consumer.big_ticket: DIY big-ticket discretionary demand remained soft due to elevated borrowing costs; smaller outdoor projects held up.
consumer.pricing: Modest price increases contributed to ticket growth.

macro_read: Rates are the binding constraint on home-related durables; spending shifts to Pro and smaller projects while DIY traffic falls.

sources.label: Reuters via Tiger: Lowe's trims forecasts, profit beat lifts shares
